note: Things to find in Oak Meadow and Vasona. Keep these few. Placement keys are described in main-street.json, plus: rail (a fraction along the train's run) and lake (a compass direction on the lake shore: 0 north, 0.25 east, 0.5 south, 0.75 west). lookout: true lowers the camera to look south to the mountains. ending: true makes this the closing moment of the wander. shore: true moves a spot down to the nearest lake shore.

spots.title: The Carousel
spots.blurb: Built for San Francisco's 1915 exposition, and restored here by volunteers.

spots.title: An engineer's neckerchief
spots.blurb: Red, a little sooty, and just your size. The steam train has run in this park since 1970.

spots.title: Vasona Lake
spots.blurb: Pedal boats, kayaks and little sailboats go out from here in the warm months. There is a rowing boat at the pier.

spots.title: Vasona Dam
spots.blurb: The north end of the lake. Look back: the whole town lies between here and the mountains.
